Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for sponsoring the San Diego satellite roundtable last week — it went really well. We planned for 120 attendees based on the promo batch you gave us, but final check-in was 172 and many registrants redeemed the trial codes during the event. We've exhausted the 150 credits you originally allocated.

Attached is attendee-usage.csv with the redemption rows and a short notes column from our events ops team. Can Redwood provision an additional 60 promo credits so we don't have any live redemptions failing this week? We can cover a partial invoiced amount if needed, but requesting a goodwill top-up to cover overage first.

Event details: BrightLoop Roundtable — SD — 2026-12-15

Promo batch: RBW-SD-DEC15

Best,
